notes: Bytes. Measured on 2026-11-02 (docs/reports/package-sizes-2026-11-02.md) and rounded up by about 3%. null: not measured yet, so not checked. A finished package over its ceiling fails the packaging script: change the number in the same change and say why. One more than 10% under it only prints a warning to lower the number. A name that is not one of these kinds is an error. 2026-11-04: the x86_64 .deb measured 17751068 bytes at the release dry run of 0.1.0 (3% over the ceiling of 2026-11-02, from the changes merged since) and is now 18300000; the x86_64 AppImage measured 24611320 and is now checked at 25400000.
